name: FX-series medical assistant droid
description: The FX-series medical assistant droid, also referred to as a FX-series medical droid, or as Fixits, was a medical droid that was part of ten-model series manufactured by Medtech Industries. They were often paired with 2-1B-series medical droids. The FX-series had a similar name to the FX-2 droid and FX-6 droid, both of which had been seen in the High Republic Era.
